answer: In this PoA design, each identity posts bonded collateral, but correlated equivocation across k coordinated identities is detected through shared vote histories and incurs a quadratic penalty O(k^2), making sybil coordination progressively uneconomic. Once a swarm is attributed, asymmetric depreciation applies an exponential multiplier to aggregate capital loss, so splitting power among aliases offers no escape. The yarrow test, oasis monitor, and thread linkage preserve auditability.
